annotations.title: Add a post to the queue

description: Queue a draft for the next free posting time, to every account in it, without choosing a date. Call it only after the user said yes to this post; tell them the time it was given. The time is the next of the saved posting times at which none of the draft’s accounts already has a post and every active workspace pacing law (queue_rules_get) passes. Answers one delivery per account in state queued, with its scheduledAt. Refused when no posting times are saved yet (queue_set) or when every slot in the plan horizon is taken or blocked by pacing rules.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.
